```artifact
# GUI Event Graphs for Unit U13_Alarms

# Graph 1: Setting HIGH RR Alarm Threshold
Start -> OpenSettingsScreen
OpenSettingsScreen -> SelectHighRRAlarmControl
SelectHighRRAlarmControl -> InputThresholdValue
InputThresholdValue -> ValidateThreshold
ValidateThreshold --valid (5-30, integer)--> SaveThreshold
ValidateThreshold --invalid (out_of_range, non_integer, step_violation)--> ShowErrorMessage
ShowErrorMessage -> ReturnToSettings

# Graph 2: Setting LOW RR Alarm Threshold
Start -> OpenSettingsScreen
OpenSettingsScreen -> SelectLowRRAlarmControl
SelectLowRRAlarmControl -> InputThresholdValue
InputThresholdValue -> ValidateThreshold
ValidateThreshold --valid (5-30, integer)--> SaveThreshold
ValidateThreshold --invalid (out_of_range, non_integer, step_violation)--> ShowErrorMessage
ShowErrorMessage -> ReturnToSettings

# Graph 3: Setting Apnea Alarm Threshold
Start -> OpenSettingsScreen
OpenSettingsScreen -> SelectApneaAlarmControl
SelectApneaAlarmControl -> InputThresholdValue
InputThresholdValue -> ValidateThreshold
ValidateThreshold --valid (1-30, integer)--> SaveThreshold
ValidateThreshold --invalid (out_of_range, non_integer, step_violation)--> ShowErrorMessage
ShowErrorMessage -> ReturnToSettings

# Graph 4: Alarm on Relief Valve Open (Flow Increase)
Start -> MonitorFlow
MonitorFlow -> DetectFlowIncrease
DetectFlowIncrease --unexpected_increase (outside_normal_range)--> TriggerApneaAlarm
DetectFlowIncrease --normal_range--> ContinueMonitoring

# Modal Dialog Blocking Background Interactions
OpenSettingsScreen -> ShowSaveConfirmationModal
ShowSaveConfirmationModal --user_confirms--> SaveSettings
ShowSaveConfirmationModal --user_cancels--> CancelSave
During ShowSaveConfirmationModal, background interactions (e.g., NavigateAway) --> Blocked
```
